name: Launch Teaser
tagline: A name, one promise and a few real clips go in, a 15-second teaser that lands the name on the beat comes out.
description: A short teaser for launch day or the week before: a few big words, fast glimpses of the real product, a beat drop on the name, and the date, link or install command. It makes people curious instead of explaining everything. Good as a post on its own or at the end of a thread.
bring: The name and one line about what it does
A few short clips or screenshots of the real product
The date, link or install command to end on
get: A 10–20 s teaser with music and sound effects (16:9, or 9:16 on request)

needs.name: Teaser starter scene and music script
Hyperframes (or your project's video tool), Python 3 and ffmpeg
Music, if you want a real track

steps: Write the few words and pick the one visual idea
Lay everything out on a music beat
Cut the best moments from your clips
Make the music and sound effects for this exact cut
Review each version in FrameJam until it's right
